title: The capacity region of the general two-user interference channel
formal: Characterize the capacity region of an arbitrary discrete memoryless two-user interference channel with independent private messages, separate encoders and no feedback.
context:
Finite alphabets and a specified channel law define the model. The existing Gaussian interference-channel question is an independently significant special case, not an equivalent formulation.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: A canonical unresolved network-information-theory model in which independent communications compete through interference.
